She listened and never rushed. I was very nervous for the visit b/c I had such a horrible experience with the animal clinic in my neighborhood…the staff was so understanding and accommodating. There are two Drs there, and the office is clean, no frills—but great care.
My one criticism is that this vet clinic is also Private Equity Owned— PE is all about money and making as much money as they can for their client portfolios. Most frequently they destroy businesses—cutting quality. Running every business like a moneymaking machine. FORTUNATELY, the pvt equity group that owns this clinic has not ruined it yet!

Excellent customer service by staff and they took excellent care of my dog with patience and expertise.
I highly recommend Broadway Animal Hospital of Riverdale.

I brought my dog in because he was sick and needed a same day appointment. Before the visit, I informed the receptionist that my dog would need to be muzzled for the exam through the phone. The receptionist was very sweet and helpful. However, the veterinarian and assistant had asked me to put the muzzle on him myself. I explained that my dog doesn’t allow me to do that, which is why veterinary staff have always handled it at other clinics. Instead of attempting to help, they told me that if he wouldn’t let me do it, he wouldn’t let them either. No real examination was performed, they simply observed him from a distance and said he looked fine, yet I was still charged an exam fee. I was also disappointed when the assistant laughed and commented that my dog wasn’t friendly, despite me explaining that he is sweet and only fearful at the vet. I was already stressed about my dog’s health, finding a last-minute appointment, and missing work, so this experience was frustrating. Although the practice manager later offered suggestions for future visits, I felt those options should have been provided by the veterinary staff during my appointment. As a first-time visitor to this clinic, I was disappointed by the experience I received. I only came here because my regular clinic, Inwood Animal Clinic, was fully booked and unable to fit my dog in the time I needed for today. In the future, I would strongly recommend Inwood Animal Clinic, as they have consistently provided compassionate care, thorough examinations, and professional handling of my pet.

We have been working with Broadway Animal Hospital of Riverdale for over 10 years.  The entire staff does a terrific job from the receptionist, to the technicians and Dr. Chan - our dog actually enjoys her visits!  Crystal, the office manager, has also gone above and beyond for us in settlement of an administrative issue.  We have been thoroughly impressed by every facet of Broadway Animal Hospital and highly recommend them to anyone in need of a veterinary clinic.
The doctor and staff are friendly, caring and supportive. They listen to the patients and work to help your pet.

We took our cat sammy to a vet around morris heights where they did not give him proper treatment for his ear mites and skin condition. They just sent us home with medication and they sedated him to “clean” the ear mites. When we asked the vet if he the ear mites were gone they looked inside and said yes but his ears still had mites and the problem was worse.

We then decided to look for another vet and came across this place and they did an AMAZING job on Sammy. Literally nothing like the last vet we went to. We took Sammy to a consultation where the vet checked him out and told us the necessary steps she will take to make sure he gets better. After she told us what needed to be done and what she will do, she gave us an estimate on how much it was going to be. We decided to take a chance and bring Sammy the next day to get treated. Instead of sending us home with medication to treat him ourselves like the last place did they actually took measures to treat him their selves His ear mites turned out to be a yeast infection, and when we picked him up from the vet his ears were completely cleaned. They also treated a skin rash that Sammy had. Since the visit Sammy looks 100% better. He’s no longer scratching and he seems very happy. I am very pleased with the services and highly recommend this spot.
Thank you guys
